newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Dow's plunge pushes Kuala Lumpur to weak close.
newsitem.headline: Dow's plunge pushes Kuala Lumpur to weak close.

text.p: Kuala Lumpur blue chips joined secondary issues to a lower close on Tuesday as the plunge of the Dow cast a cloud over trading, dealers said.
Wall Street's performance later on Tuesday will be closely monitored as it will set the tone for Wednesday, they said.
"The first fall is done today. Whatever bad things happening tonight will affect us again," said an institutional dealer at a Malaysian brokerage.
At the close, the key Composite Index was down 11.06 points or 1.02 percent to 1,077.92. The Second Board index fell 3.87 points or 0.67 percent to 570.16.
"A sharp drop in overseas markets put a further dampener on already depressed prices," GK Goh Stockbrokers said in its market commentary. The Dow ended down 2.5 percent on Monday.
Dealers said in typical fashion, the Malaysian market closely followed the large falls of the Dow, but not its gains.
Large-capitalised stocks Telekom, Maybank, Tenaga, Tanjong and United Engineers fell between 10 and 50 cents.
Tobacco stocks weakened further on worries of spillover effects from a landmark U.S. tobacco litigation agreement.
